plan_name: Origin Affinity Variable Ongoing - My Connect

fees.description: A $15.07 (GST Incl) fee may apply when your property is reconnected (including when you move). Fee may vary.
A $15.07 (GST Incl) fee may apply when your property is disconnected (including when you move). Fee may vary.
A fee of $15.00 (GST exempt) may apply if your bill is not paid by the due date.
If you pay at an Australia Post outlet, a payment processing fee of the higher of $2.70 or 0.49% (incl GST) may apply.
$2.15 (incl GST) may apply for each paper bill.

c.terms: Offer not available in all areas or properties connecting for first time. Residential customers only. Visit originenergy.com.au/2889/Terms-and-conditions for more.
c.variation: We may vary the Charges (including their amount, nature and structure) by notice to you at any time. The notice will be at least 5 business days prior to the effective date of the variation.
c.additionalFeeInformation: You may be required to pay any amounts that a Distributor or Meter Service Provider charges us for services provided at your Supply Address, including any metering-related goods or services, and which are not already incorporated into the Supply Charges or Energy Usage Charges. You can find out more at www.originenergy.com.au/2402/Additional-charges

c.variation: We may vary our standing offer rates no more than once every six months. If we vary our rates, we will publish the variation in a newspaper and on our website at least 10 business days prior to the effective date. If we vary our rates, we will also provide you written notice of at least 5 business days prior to the variation. Where the variation is a reduction in the tariff or charge payable by you, we will provide you written notice as soon as practicable and no later than your next bill.
